Overview

Cine AI Hackfest by Lorven AI Studio is an offline, high-energy AI x Filmmaking hackathon designed to bring together developers and filmmakers to reimagine the future of cinema using artificial intelligence.

Hosted in Hyderabad, this two-day hackathon challenges participants to explore how AI can transform storytelling, production, editing, and film marketing. From automating post-production workflows to building intelligent storytelling tools, Cine AI Hackfest is where technology meets creativity.

Whether you’re a coder experimenting with generative AI, a filmmaker curious about automation, or a creator looking to build something bold — this hackathon is your playground.

Participants will collaborate in teams, build real working prototypes, and present their solutions to an expert panel. The best ideas stand a chance to win exciting cash prizes and gain recognition in the growing AI-film ecosystem.

🚀 Build. Create. Disrupt Cinema with AI.

ABOUT LORVEN AI

Lorven AI Studio is India's first AI-driven filmmaking platform, launched by acclaimed producer Dil Raju, known for films like Vakeel saab, Fida, Balagam and many more

Built for filmmakers, writers, and producers, Lorven AI optimizes both creative and production workflows—without compromising artistic intent.

The platform brings together four powerful modules:

  • Cine Scribe — From idea to production-ready scripts
  • Cine Sketch — Instant cinematic storyboards
  • Pitch Craft — Investor- and studio-ready pitch decks, auto-generated
  • Cine Flow — End-to-end planning with scheduling, locations, and call sheets.

Lorven AI empowers creators to move faster, plan smarter, and deliver films with sharper control over timelines and budgets.

Themes

Persistent Character Memory & Consistency System

AI-generated storyboard and previz images often suffer from character inconsistency across frames, scenes, and prompts. This is one of the most expensive and unsolved problems in AI-based film production. Your task is to build a Character Memory System that preserves a character’s identity across multiple generations.

Ai Machine LearningRead more

Multimodal Scene Intent & Visual Planning Engine

Scripts describe actions and dialogue, but scene intent — including emotion, mood, and visual tone — is often implicit and not directly stated. Your task is to build an AI system that extracts creative intent from a script and converts it into structured visual planning signals that can be used by downstream tools such as storyboard generators, directors’ assistants, or previz systems.

Ai Machine LearningRead more

AI-Based Scene Feasibility & Risk Predictor

Many scenes look compelling on paper but are high-risk, costly, or difficult to execute during production. Your task is to build an AI system that analyzes a scene and predicts production feasibility and risk using reasoning-based evaluation.

Ai Machine LearningRead more

Semantic Footage Search Engine

Editors often struggle to find the right footage using intent-based queries such as “hesitant reaction before answering” or “tense pause before dialogue”. Your task is to build a semantic search engine that enables intelligent retrieval of footage based on meaning, not keywords.

Ai Machine LearningRead more

Multimodal Best-Take Selection Assistant

Selecting the best take from multiple recordings is often subjective, time-consuming, and dependent on human judgment. Your task is to build an AI assistant that evaluates multiple takes using multimodal signals and ranks them based on performance quality and alignment with the script.

Ai Machine LearningRead more

Anti-Piracy Content Protection

Create an advanced AI-based content fingerprinting system that generates unique audio-visual signatures for films, enabling real-time detection and removal of pirated content across social media platforms, messaging apps, and streaming services.

Ai Machine LearningRead more

Eligibility

All participants are eligible to register for Cine AI Hackfest

Rules

General Rules

  • This is an offline hackathon; all team members must be present on both days.
  • Teams must consist of 2–4 members only.
  • All ideas must be original and developed during the hackathon period.
  • Pre-built projects or reused codebases are not allowed.
  • AI tools and APIs are allowed, but must be clearly disclosed.
  • Any form of plagiarism will lead to immediate disqualification.
  • The decision of the judges and organizers will be final and binding.

Submission Rules

  • Each team must submit:
    • Project demo (working prototype)
    • Brief explanation of solution
    • Tech stack used
    • Use case & impact
  • Final submission must be done before the deadline shared on hack day.
  • Teams must present their project during the demo round.

Evaluation Criteria

  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Relevance to Theme
  • Technical Implementation
  • Practical Use Case
  • Presentation & Demo Quality
